remarks: Welcome to Cambridge Lofts, where urban convenience meets modern loft-style living. This 8th-floor condo is an excellent opportunity for students, professionals, investors, or those looking for a property with Airbnb/short-term rental potential. Featuring soaring ceilings, newer  flooring, and a newer washer and dryer, this stylish unit is move-in ready. Located just off Jasper Avenue, you’ll enjoy exceptional access to Central LRT Station, with a bus stop conveniently located right outside the building. Walk to Rogers Place, the Downtown Farmers’ Market, the Art Gallery, restaurants, shopping, entertainment, and Edmonton’s beautiful River Valley trail system. Commuting to the University of Alberta and NAIT is quick and convenient via ETS and the LRT. Whether you’re looking to live, work, study, invest, or operate an Airbnb/short-term rental , this property offers outstanding flexibility in one of downtown Edmonton’s most connected locations.
